summary: Distinct micro-skill addressing link-specific rendering context and precision configuration. While peer candidate 'Arc Rendering Context Configuration' covers the same pattern for arcs, this skill is necessary because link generators (d3.link, d3.linkVertical, d3.linkHorizontal, d3.linkRadial) are a separate D3 API family with different path generation semantics. No redundancy detected among peers. Support evidence confirms API availability.
